John Brown appears in 109 recordings across 14 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive in 1951. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear John Brown most often in The Damon Runyon Theatre, A Date with Judy, The Fred Allen Show, Duffy's Tavern, The Abbott and Costello Show, The Whistler, The Shadow, and Strange Wills.

Characters credited here include Broadway.
